Subject: GCP partner manager opportunity hub sync - need final agenda and docs

Hi all —

Quick note to get a focused joint pipeline review on the calendar for next week so we can align on co-sell priorities for Q2. Proposed objectives: 

- Surface top 10 GCP-opportunities across partners (Acme, Quantum Health, ClearSight)
- Confirm committed capacity / billing tier expectations per opp
- Identify blockers (security questionnaire, procurement, trial infra) and owners
- Agree next-step play for each high-priority opp (demo, SOW, pilot)

Attached is a working spreadsheet (gcp-opps-hub-q2.xlsx) with columns I've started. Please add rows/notes for any accounts you own before EOD.

Time options for a 60m sync: Tue 4/13 9:30–10:30 PDT or Wed 4/14 11:00–12:00 PDT. If neither works, propose alternatives.

Please also confirm if you want GCP PMs to see the raw sheet or a curated deck (I can prepare a 6-slide summary).

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partner & GTM Ops | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
